## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what triggered the problem or motivated the feature, and how this change helps.

## Validation

List meaningful checks and the flows you tried. Include screenshots for visible UI changes and the device/iOS version where relevant. Redact personal data and secrets.

- [ ] Ran contributor checks in development mode, or explained why unavailable.
- [ ] Built and exercised the affected flow, or described the remaining validation.
- [ ] Kept original evidence/recovered resources intact and identified new behavior.
- [ ] Preserved licenses and included no credentials or private app/user data.

## Compatibility and limits

Mention data migrations, changed dependencies, signing/installation effects, and known gaps when applicable.
